versions.changelog:
- Skill renamed from “yunlv-guangjiao-FAI” to “yunlv-cantonfair”
- Notification/messaging API switched to user-configured and now only generates message templates for users to copy and send (no direct automated messaging)
- Updated feature descriptions to clarify that messages (emails/WhatsApp etc.) are generated for user action, not autopilot contact
- Cleaned up and simplified instructions for contacting leads, focusing on assisting the user to prepare outreach rather than sending on their behalf
- Minor updates to permissions: clarified no direct third-party messaging or data sharing; user copies message content for outreach
Fix metadata: remove curl dependency from bins

yunlv-guangjiao-FAI v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Enables AI-driven lead mining from Canton Fair (广交会) exhibitor and buyer data.
- Supports structured client list export with contact info, booth numbers, product interests, and MatchGPT scoring.
- Automates personalized outreach (email/WhatsApp) and follow-up task setting.
- Offers workflow for exhibitor/buyer discovery by keyword, industry, or company name.
- Integrates reference resources: product category list, outreach templates, follow-up strategies.
- Built-in compliance checks for data usage and privacy.
